meta.dataset_note: Since LM2 Torah 2 data has not yet been entered into torahData.js, all packages proposed here are based entirely on the source text (torah_2.txt). They will need to be created as bechina edges in the dataset before they can be reflected in torah_2_packages.json.

new_packages.label: הֲלָכוֹת וְהוֹדָאָה — שַׁעֲשׁוּעַ עוֹלָם הַבָּא
new_packages.label_en: Halakhot and Thanksgiving — Delight of the World to Come
new_packages.reason: These nodes all share the essential nature of שעשוע עולם הבא (the delight of the World to Come). Thanksgiving (הודאה) IS the World to Come's delight; halachot (הלכות) IS the World to Come's delight; the todah-offering (תודה) IS halachot; the kindnesses of God (חסדי ה') ARE halachot; serving Torah scholars (שמוש חכמים) IS halachot; the orderly flow of blood (תהלוכות הדמים) IS halachah (etymologically: הלכה = הליכה); and childbirth (הולדה) IS halachah. The moon's deficiency (חסרון) and its future filling (מלוי החסרון) are the cosmic metaphor for this entire domain. All these are different faces of the same spiritual reality: the joy of knowing and acknowledging God, which is what the learning and transmission of Jewish law embodies.

new_packages.notes: This is the primary package of LM2 Torah 2 — the opening argument of the entire Torah. The chain of equivalences (הודאה = שעשוע עולם הבא = תודה = הלכות = חסדי ה' = תהלוכות הדמים = הולדה) is the backbone of the Torah's first three sections (aleph through gimel). The לבנה metaphor (lines 12–13) ties the cosmic dimension (moon's future fullness) to the personal/practical dimension (birth, blood, support of Torah study).

new_packages.label: אֱמֶת וּשְׁלֵמוּת הַדִּבּוּר
new_packages.label_en: Truth and the Perfection of Speech
new_packages.reason: These nodes all share the essential nature of the perfection of speech through truth. The fourfold speech (ריבוע הדבור) achieves its completeness (שלמות) only through truth (אמת). The three divine names (אל אלקים ה') are the sources of truth that illuminate the four dimensions of speech. Each dimension has its own form: speech of charity (דבור של צדקה), speech of repentance (דבור של תשובה), speech of wealth (דבור של עשירות), speech of kingship (דבור של מלכות = מלכות פה). The Holy Language (לשון הקדש) is the expression of this perfected speech. The four objects used by Rabbi Eliezer (חרוב, אמת המים, כתלי בית המדרש, בת קול) are the four dimensions of speech made manifest in the physical world.

new_packages.notes: This is the second major cluster of LM2 Torah 2, covering sections ד–ה (lines 16–33). The dominant node is אמת (truth) with connections to all other nodes through the speech framework. The three divine names (אל = תפלה, אלקים = תורה, ה' = שידוכים) function as a sub-cluster within this package — they are the sources (מקור) of truth that flow into the speech domain. Note the connection to Package 1: תפלה and תורה from this Torah's existing dataset packages (Packages 1 and 2) are re-engaged here, but in the role of 'sources of truth for speech' — this is an eitza connection FROM those packages TO this new package, not a bechina merger.

new_packages.label: שַׁבָּת וְשִׂמְחָה — אַחְדוּת הַפָּשׁוּט
new_packages.label_en: Shabbat and Joy — Simple Divine Unity
new_packages.reason: These nodes share the essential nature of the Shabbat principle as the revelation of divine unity. Shabbat IS a son (בן) — not a servant but a child with inherent dignity. It IS rest for all existence (נַיְחָא דְּעִלָּאִין וְתַתָּאִין). The drawing of Shabbat joy into the six weekdays reveals the simple unity (אחדות הפשוט) that underlies all diversity. Metatron (מטט) = servant (עבד) = sadness (עצבות) = weekdays; Shabbat = son (בן) = joy (שמחה) = unity. The servant/son axis is the structural polarity of this package.

new_packages.mirror_package: The servant/son axis contains an embedded polarity: עבד/מטטרון/עצבות form the negative pole within this package (not a separate evil package, since they represent the weekday dimension that is potentially elevated, not a hostile force). The Chanukah concept of 'חנוך' (Enoch/Metatron, line 51) shows that even the weekday-servant dimension is being sanctified through the Chanukah festival.
new_packages.notes: This package spans sections ה–ו of the Torah (lines 30–38). The principle 'יחיד ורבים הלכה כרבים' (lines 37–38) is given as a practical illustration of אחדות הפשוט — diverse individual opinions converging into one halakhic ruling mirrors the theological reality of diverse created things flowing from the one simple God. This is also why God declared 'נִצְּחוּנִי בָּנַי' (My children have defeated Me) — because the majority rule reveals the son-like quality (בן = שבת) that God most cherishes.

new_packages.label: נֵר חֲנֻכָּה וְאוֹר הָאֱמֶת
new_packages.label_en: Chanukah Light and the Light of Truth
new_packages.reason: These nodes are the synthesis cluster that ties all of LM2 Torah 2 together. Chanukah = חנו כה = Shabbat rest. The Chanukah oil (שמן) IS the light of truth (אור האמת). The Chanukah lamp (נר חנוכה) placed near the door IS the opening of the mouth (פתחי פיך), i.e., speech. The figure of Enoch (חנוך) = Metatron = the weekday dimension being sanctified by the Chanukah light. All four themes of the Torah (Halakhot/hoda'ah, Truth/speech, Shabbat/unity, and their synthesis in Chanukah oil/light) converge in this final cluster.

new_packages.notes: This synthesis cluster (lines 47–51) is the Torah's conclusion. It demonstrates that all the preceding themes (halachah/hoda'ah, truth/speech, Shabbat/joy) are simultaneously present in the Chanukah festival. The oil heals the lungs (רפואה לרֵאָה, lines 55–56) — a physiological note that connects the spiritual oil-of-truth to the physical body's respiration and moisture, completing the body metaphor begun with the blood/heart imagery in section bet. This package has the fewest nodes but the highest integrative function in the Torah's argument.

observations:
LM2 Torah 2 contains four substantial independent concept clusters, none of which are represented in the current dataset. The four clusters are not merely additions to existing packages — they form entirely new package families with their own dominant nodes and internal bechina networks:

1. NEW_A (Halakhot/Thanksgiving/World to Come): 13 nodes, ~8 bechina edges. This is the Torah's opening argument and most densely connected cluster. הלכות is the dominant hub with 5+ direct bechina connections.

2. NEW_B (Truth/Speech): 16 nodes, ~7+ bechina edges. This is the Torah's central argument. אמת is the dominant node. The four-part speech structure (ריבוע הדבור) and its four physical manifestations (חרוב, אמת המים, כתלי בית המדרש, בת קול) make this a structurally rich package.

3. NEW_C (Shabbat/Joy/Unity): 7 nodes, ~4 bechina edges. The theological climax of the Torah. שבת is the dominant node with the servant/son polarity embedded within it.

4. NEW_D (Chanukah synthesis): 5 nodes, ~4 bechina edges. The synthesis cluster that ties everything together. חנוכה functions as the name of the whole Torah's synthesis.

The good/evil mirror structure in LM2 Torah 2: Unlike LM1 Torah 2 which has a clear evil package (Package 4: קלקול המשפט/מחשבות זרות), LM2 Torah 2 does not develop a full evil counterpackage. The negative poles (עצבות, חסרון, the blood flooding the heart) are embedded within good packages as the 'before' state that gets rectified. This may reflect the different rhetorical strategy of LM2 — the Rebbe focuses more on the positive redemptive arc than on naming and analyzing the evil forces.

Cross-Torah node connections: Several nodes in the new packages will connect to other Torahs via shared concepts: אמת, דבור, לשון הקדש, שבת, and מלכות are all likely high-degree cross-Torah bridge nodes. The connection of אמת → דבור → לשון הקדש → שבת is a particularly important structural chain.
